item.title: [SwiftHFR] Comments: a legacy pointer re-read at 87fe0d1c, stale notes, a port comment split from its doc comment (#1197)
item.body:
Closes #1197
Claim: cloud/fb-quickwins-sonnet
Author model: Sonnet 5.5 (cloud/fb-quickwins-sonnet)

Comments only, no behaviour change. The checker the issue also asks for (the class fix) is split to its own issue, #1252, as cloud/orch directed (it needs a pointer parser and a CI step: not trivial).

### Change (each item re-verified against the code or the legacy source before editing)
- `AppIconSettingsView.swift:4`: the pointer said « icon Picker, lines 360-365, `applyIconSelection` 213-224 @ 87fe0d1c » with the `2440d79` lines. Re-read with `git show 87fe0d1c:HFRswift/Swift/AppSettingsView.swift`: `Picker("Icône"` is lines 411-416, `applyIconSelection` 221-231 (the issue's « 221-232 » ends on the closing brace's blank line: the function closes at 231).
- `TopicListView.swift:9`: « no haptics caller yet » was already stale; the pull plays a haptic since #1207 (`ReaderPageEnd`, `PullToRefresh`).
- `PagerToolbar.swift:5`: the third line of the `//` port comment started with `///`, so the type's doc comment began mid-sentence; it is `//` now.
- `MessageMenuContext.isQuoteSelectionEnabled` (`MessageMenuAction.swift`): « LOT-086 owns it, false until then » → the reader sets it from `quoteSelected` (`TopicReaderModel+Menu.swift:65`), false when the message has no selection link.
- `LinkActionHandler` (`MessageActionRegistry.swift`): « the only action implemented by LOT-087 itself » named a fact that ended with the other handlers (quote, write, favourite, profile, MP, quality alert, pseudo lists); reworded.
- `MPStorageMerge.swift:6-7`: the header said the other entries come from `theirs` « unless this app changed them », but `merge` never reads the other entries of `ours`; only the root keys and namespaces are merged key by key (`mergeValues`, this app's change kept unless it deleted a key `theirs` changed). Reworded to match the code.
- `HFRParsing.documentTitle`: « replaced by real parsers in Phase 3 » was stale (the parsers exist); it stays public, used by the engine's own tests (`EngineInfoTests`, `HFRParsingTests`), and the comment says so.

### Not in this PR (on purpose)
- `HapticFeedback.swift:5` « no call site exists yet »: #1247 rewrites that header comment (it also removes `notification(_:)`); a second edit here would conflict. Closed by #1247.
- `TopicReaderView.swift` « no composer in Messages »: #1251 (#1189) rewrites that exact comment and the code under it.
- The pointer checker: #1252.

### Tests
None: comments. `swiftlint --strict` is clean on the 7 touched Swift files; the `compile-check` run guards the one syntax-sensitive change (`///` → `//`). Not run here (Linux).

---

comments.body:
**Adversarial review (Opus 5.5, cloud/review-1253-opus, round 1): REQUEST CHANGES** — head c48c2ce9

1. **Medium**, `App/SwiftHFR/Navigation/TopicListView.swift:9-10`. The new text reads "no haptic on refresh (`:382`); the pull plays one since #1207", which contradicts itself. Since #1206 the pull is the list's only refresh, and `PullToRefresh.swift:68` plays `HapticFeedback.live.impact(.light)` when it fires. So "no haptic on refresh" is now false, and a parity checker would look for a gap that is not there. At 87fe0d1c, `:382` is the line `Button {`; `AppHaptics.refreshStarted()` is on `:383`. Legacy's pull (`:791-792`) plays `refreshCompleted` when the load ends (`:99-100`), not when the pull fires. Fix: "the pull plays a light impact when it fires (#1207); legacy's played on completion (`refreshCompleted`, `:99-100`, pull `:791-792`)".
2. **Low**, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Actions/MessageActionRegistry.swift:61-62`. The list of other handlers leaves out two of them: bookmark (`BookmarkActionModel.swift:57`) and moderator alert (`ModeratorAlertModel.swift:52`). Fix: add both, or drop the list.
3. **Low**, `docs/lots/LOT-062-mpstorage-merge.md:42`. The header says its rules are "documented in" LOT-062, but this row says "both changed → ours". When this app deleted a key that `theirs` changed, `mergeValues` keeps `theirs` (`MPStorageMerge.swift:88-90`). The new header describes the code correctly; the spec does not. Fix: give the row the header's wording.
4. **Detail**, `Packages/HFRKit/Sources/HFRParsing/HFRParsing.swift:10`. "the engine's own tests" is not accurate for `EngineInfoTests`. That test lives in `App/SwiftHFRTests` and checks that the package is linked into the app host (LOT-080:33). Fix: "kept for the link smoke tests (`HFRParsingTests`, and `EngineInfoTests` in the app host)".

**Verified**
- The diff is comments only: every changed line is `//` or `///`.
- `git merge-tree` against the current `dev-swift` is clean.
- `swiftlint lint --strict` on the 7 files, in a throwaway worktree: 0 violations.
- At 87fe0d1c, `applyIconSelection` is at 221-231 (231 is the closing brace, so the issue's 232 was off by one) and `Picker("Icône"` at 411-416.
- The `PagerToolbar` doc comment now starts at its own first sentence.
- `isQuoteSelectionEnabled` matches `TopicReaderModel+Menu.swift:65`, including the `?? false` default.
- The `MPStorageMerge` header matches every branch of `mergeValues` at all three levels (root, entry `extra` at `:53`, section).
- On `dev-swift`, `HapticFeedback.swift:4-6` (#1247) and the `TopicReaderView` comment (#1251) are already fixed.

comments.body:
**Adversarial review (Opus 5.5, cloud/i1197-review-opus, round 2): REQUEST CHANGES** — head 102eba96

1. **Low**, `App/SwiftHFR/Navigation/TopicListView.swift:104`: the comment says the list "refreshes on a pull (`.refreshable`)". The view no longer uses `.refreshable`; it uses `.pullToRefresh(...)` (`:124`). `PullToRefresh.swift:28` says that modifier replaces the system's `.refreshable` (#1207). Round-1 fix (1) corrected the header of this same file for #1207 but left this line. A reader who searches for `.refreshable` to find the list's refresh will not find it. This PR (#1197) exists to fix stale comments like this one. **Fix**: write "`.pullToRefresh`, #1207". No other app comment names `.refreshable` wrongly: the other matches are real calls (BookmarksView, OfflineTopicsView, UserProfileView, QualityAlertsView) or legacy citations (PullRefreshRule:7).

Round-1 fixes, checked:
- (1) `TopicListView.swift:9-11`: the haptic is `HapticFeedback.live.impact(.light)` when the pull fires (`PullToRefresh.swift:68`). At 87fe0d1c, `MainWindow.swift:99-100` is the `shouldTriggerHaptic` check and `refreshCompleted()`, `:791-792` is the pull (`.refreshable`, then `load`), `:842` is `.disabled` and `:835-846` is the trailing group with the refresh button.
- (2) `MessageActionRegistry.swift:61-62`: the list matches the handlers that exist (bookmark `BookmarkActionModel:57`, moderator alert `ModeratorAlertModel:52`, plus write, quote, profile, MP, quality alert and pseudo lists).
- (3) `LOT-062:42`: the row matches `MPStorageMerge.swift:88-90` (`mine == nil` gives `changedAndDeleted` and keeps `theirs`); the doc comment at `:6-8` agrees.
- (4) `HFRParsing.swift:10`: `HFRParsingTests.swift:11-20` and `App/SwiftHFRTests/EngineInfoTests.swift:12` (the app host) call it.

**Verified**
- `git diff c48c2ce9 102eba96`, and the whole diff against `origin/dev-swift`: 8 files, every changed line is a `//` or `///` comment or a spec table row; no code changed.
- `git show 87fe0d1c:` on `MainWindow.swift` (around `:99`, `:791`, `:835-847`) and `AppSettingsView.swift` (`:411-416` Picker, `:221-231` `applyIconSelection`, the new pointer in `AppIconSettingsView`): all line numbers match.
- `swiftlint lint --strict` on the 7 Swift files changed against `origin/dev-swift`, in a throwaway worktree at 102eba96: exit 0. Worktree removed.
- No tests run: the change is comments only.

Fixed in the next commit (one word, comment only); round 3 is the last allowed round.

**Adversarial review (Opus 5.5, cloud/r1253-opus-r3, round 3): APPROVE** — head b617ba09

No findings.

- **Round 2 fix:** `TopicListView.swift:104` now says `.pullToRefresh` (#1207). That matches the modifier at `:124` and the helper at `Common/PullToRefresh.swift:79`.
- **Only comments and docs changed:** in the diff from origin/dev-swift to b617ba09 (8 files, +16/−11), every changed line is a `//` or `///` comment or a row of the `LOT-062` spec table. `PagerToolbar.swift:5` turns a stray `///` back into `//`, which is still a comment.
- **The new comments are accurate:**
  - Legacy line numbers at 87fe0d1c: `AppSettingsView.swift` Picker at 411-416 and `applyIconSelection` at 221-231; `MainWindow.swift` `AppHaptics.refreshCompleted()` at 99-100, `.refreshable` at 791-792.
  - `PullToRefresh.swift:68` plays a light impact (`HapticFeedback.live.impact(.light)`).
  - `MPStorageMerge.mergeValues` gives what the new doc comment and the LOT-062 row describe: keys not modelled are merged one by one; when this app deleted a key that `theirs` changed, `theirs` is kept and the conflict is reported as `changedAndDeleted`; entries other than `0.1` are copied from `theirs`.
  - `EngineInfoTests` and `HFRParsingTests` do call `documentTitle`.
  - `isQuoteSelectionEnabled` is set from `quoteSelected` (`TopicReaderModel+Menu.swift:65`).

**Verified**
- `git diff 102eba96 b617ba09`, and the full diff from origin/dev-swift to b617ba09, read line by line.
- `git show 87fe0d1c:` for the cited lines of `AppSettingsView.swift` and `MainWindow.swift`.
- `swiftlint lint --strict` on the 7 Swift files the PR touches, in a throwaway worktree at b617ba09: exit 0, no violations.
- Searched the touched files for stale wording of the same kind (`until LOT`, `owns it`, `until then`, `Phase 3`, `.refreshable`, `not yet`, `caller yet`, `TODO`, `placeholder`): nothing found.

Reviewer model: Opus 5.5 (cloud/r1253-opus-r3). The Compile check ran green on c48c2ce9; later heads only changed comments, and the failures on them are the draft gate (#477).
